name: ubot
description: A horizontally-scaled control plane for marketplace seller automation. A single Django image runs four roles — web, worker, scheduler, and a per-shop agent — where a central control plane orchestrates a fleet of per-shop agent VMs. Each agent reaches a shared PostgreSQL (through PgBouncer) over a private WireGuard mesh (NetBird), so shops scale out one VM each while all state stays central. A push to main auto-deploys the control plane and rebuilds every agent in the fleet.
label: Indie
